company.shortDescription: Brumbrum is a provider of used vehicles for sale with up to 3 years of warranty that can be purchased online.
company.description:
Brumbrum is a provider of used vehicles for sale with up to 3 years of warranty that can be purchased online. The company's goal is to revolutionize the car market by offering a simple, innovative, practical, and competitive shopping experience.

Brumbrum was founded in 2016 and is based in Milan, Italy.

productsAndServices.description: Online platform offering a wide range of used cars from various brands, available for purchase with verified mileage and detailed inspection reports.
productsAndServices.name: Used Vehicles for Sale

productsAndServices.description: A facility in Reggio Emilia where used cars undergo thorough inspection, mechanical repairs, bodywork, and cleaning before sale.
productsAndServices.name: Vehicle Reconditioning and Inspection (Factory brumbrum)

productsAndServices.description: Options for customers to receive purchased vehicles via home delivery across Italy or to pick them up at the Factory or partner centers.
productsAndServices.name: Vehicle Delivery and Pickup Services

productsAndServices.description: Online financing options allowing customers to purchase used cars with payment plans, including customizable rates.
productsAndServices.name: Vehicle Financing Services

productsAndServices.description: A 12-month warranty on used vehicles covering defects and breakdowns, with optional extension up to 3 years, including roadside assistance in Italy and Europe.
productsAndServices.name: Warranty and Roadside Assistance

productsAndServices.description: Allows customers to return purchased vehicles within 14 days or 1,000 km for a full refund if conditions are met.
productsAndServices.name: Vehicle Return Policy

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,418,776 to $541,674,311, a 122.58x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 79 (-14 over 90 days) and market heat at 11 (-22).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
